sources.name: UNODC World Drug Report statistical annex, editions 2012, 2015, 2020 and 2026
sources.citation: UNODC, World Drug Report statistical annexes (seizure and price/purity workbooks, each edition as published).

notes: Seizures reflect enforcement and reporting, not trade volume or route exposure; homicide is general-population, not drug-attributed.

data.outcome: World Bank general-population homicide rate in year t+1, per 100,000
data.predictor: log(1 + latest published UNODC cocaine seizure kg in year t)
data.caveat: Retrospective, ecological, noncausal association. Seizures reflect enforcement/reporting, not trade volume or route exposure; homicide is general-population, not drug-attributed. Latest available UNODC annex editions and 2026 World Bank retrieval may revise past years.
data.interpretation: Retrospective ecological association only: not route validation, not a causal estimate and not a prospective forecast test.
